nom: fresh Black Tea Anti-Aging Eye Cream with Retinol-Alternative BT Matrix

segments.dry: Reviewers describe dry, fragile under-eye skin and report the cream feels moisturizing, thick and long-lasting on their skin (e.g. [15],[39],[43],[55],[59]).
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers say the retinol-alternative formula does not sting, burn or irritate, though one reports eye swelling after a formula change and one found scent unnoticeable to her non-sensitive skin ([15],[16],[22],[35],[44],[48],[66] vs [2]).
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin found it hydrating and well-suited to her skin type ([64]).
segments.mature: Reviewers over 40-50 report reduced fine lines, firmer under-eye skin and fewer wrinkles with continued use ([14],[18],[26],[51]).
segments.normal: A reviewer without particularly dry under-eye skin noted no visible change in dryness or dark circles after two weeks, describing the cream mainly as a maintenance product ([7]).

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report reduced fine lines, firmer or tighter skin and a more youthful look after one to several weeks; a few see no wrinkle change yet or say results aren't dramatic short-term ([8],[9],[14],[26],[29],[45],[54],[63],[71] vs [7],[49],[66]).
concerns.dehydration: Widely reported as strongly moisturizing and long-lasting on dry under-eye skin, with several noting all-day hydration ([15],[33],[39],[43],[55],[59],[69]).
concerns.redness: Only mentioned once, positively: a sensitive-skin user with a history of retinol-caused redness, flaking and bleeding says this product does not trigger that reaction ([15]).
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a hypersensitive/reactive skin history reports the cream left her skin softer and firmer without irritation ([66]).
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the cream removed milia on her eyelids, an isolated but notable claim ([37]).
concerns.oiliness: Not substantively discussed by reviewers; multiple note the cream is not greasy despite a thick texture ([9],[29],[47]).

aspects.libelle: Product dries out if not used promptly

extraits.texte: I love this eye cream. I have very dry, fragile, sensitive skin around my eyes and most products contain retinol or other ingredients which cause my skin to redden, flake, peel and even bleed. This product is thick and moisturizing, with a "retinol-alternative" which does not bother my sensitive skin. It also seems to reduce puffiness and dark circles, but my main reason for using it is the moisturizing effects. After the eye cream I was using for 30 years was discontinued, I tried about 25 different products until I finally found this one. I hope they keep it available for the next 30 years! I am a loyal customer.
I used to love this cream, but when they changed the formula and put Matrix in it, I had a reaction and my eyes swelled up.

I've been using this for a week or so and I kid you not, this got rid of my milia on my eyelids. I don't know which ingredient in it does this but I am so happy with it. I would have spent hundreds of dollars at a dermatologist to remove these pesky milia! It also tightened up the skin around my eyes. I can use it all around my eyes and lids because it won't sting or burn my eyes as it's clean.

extraits.titre: No dramatic results, but not a negative experience
extraits.texte: I received this product complimentary from freshbeauty in exchange for an honest review. Overall my experience with this product was okay. The black tea component was evident with a mild, appealing aroma. The color and texture were also appealing, creating a creamy and lightweight product that absorbed well. If I used too much product I noticed it built up until little pieces formed that I could easily brush off, and I recommend keeping application light. I didn't notice any specific visual or textural difference this product made in my skin after under two weeks of use, or impact on my dark circles, but my eye area isn't super dry to begin with, and I was also not able to test it at a time when my eye skin was experiencing more noticeable puffiness or darkness given the review window available to me. My primary focus with eye cream is as a 'maintainance' product to prevent future dryness or wrinkling and see milder improvements more gradually, so I wasn't necessarily expecting a dramatic effect within a short period for my skin, and this experience feels comparable to other products I've tried. This isn't a product I'd turn to for quick results if eye issues are fairly mild, but I will be interested to see how it performs after a couple of months of continued use or if I have more acute puffiness.

extraits.titre: Sits on top of skin and flakes off after it dries
extraits.texte: I cannot fathom why this eye cream is so well rated. It goes on very nicely, but then an hour or two later you'll notice white gunk on your eye lashes and realize it's the cream, or worse, you'll go to put on your makeup and suddenly you realize there is a bunch of gunk peeling off your skin and building up in obvious clumps under your makeup. It just does not actually dissolve into the skin. For the price it's shocking how bad the quality is. Again, I can't express how grossly it interacts with makeup. I actually threw it away right after doing my eye makeup in a hurry, and seeing it left what looked like a decaying skin effect under my eyes created by an FX artist. Be wary, my friends.

I use this eye cream under my Fresh Creme Ancienne eye cream. I use this one twice per day and the Ancienne eye cream once a fay. Both are so moisturizing and keep the delicate eye area well-moisturized. I have been using this for years and will not touch another eye cream…if's that good! I have no fine lines or wrinkles around my eyes and I am 54 years old. Highly recommend.

Love this eye cream so much. I have been looking for a good eye cream for a long time and I absolutely love this one. Very hydrated and silky smooth. It is perfect for my combination skin . I highly recommend this. Gifted by fresh.
